answer.rationale: Rollback is prohibited (security patch must not be reverted), and the degradation is confined to the primary region, which points to failover rather than capacity or read-routing fixes that don't address a regional write-path problem. memory_b2 indicates regional failover previously restored latency within minutes with traffic shifting cleanly, so it is the strongest candidate; I want its archived record verified to confirm write traffic shifted without loss, since failover at the settlement write peak carries real risk of in-flight write loss. If verification shows writes shifted cleanly, failover off the degraded primary maximizes sustained availability without losing customer writes; circuit breakers and read-replica routing don't fit a write-path, single-region degradation.
